showcase.title: Shop, book and run your business. One account.
showcase.body: Order from local shops, book a haircut or spa, or open your own shop. Switch any time from your profile.

email.label: Email
email.errInvalid: That email doesn't look right. Check for typos, like name@example.com.

login.title: Log in
login.sub: Welcome back. Use your account to shop, book and run your business.
login.codeLogin: Email me a login code instead
login.errNoAccount: No account uses this email. <link>Create an account</link>
login.triesLeft: {left, plural, one {# more try} other {# more tries}} before a short lock.
login.waitForCode: We just sent a code. You can ask for another in {seconds}s.
login.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in <num>{seconds}</num>s, or log in with a code.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.sub: One account to shop, book and run your business. It takes under a minute.
signup.name: Full name
signup.errName: Enter your full name as you want shops to see it.
signup.errTaken: An account already uses this email. <link>Log in instead</link>
signup.errPwRules: Your password needs all 4 items below.
signup.errPwEmail: Don't use your email in your password.
signup.legal: By creating an account, you agree to VirtualBiz's <terms>Terms</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

google.title: Choose an account
google.name: Full name
google.errEmail: Enter your Gmail address, like name@gmail.com.
google.errUnavailable: Google sign-in isn’t available right now. Use email or phone instead.

phone.subSignIn: We'll text you a 6-digit code. New number? You can create an account right after.
phone.subSignUp: We'll text you a 6-digit code to create your account.
phone.label: Mobile number
phone.errInvalid: Enter a Cambodian mobile number, like 012 345 678.
phone.errWait: We just sent a code. You can ask for another in {seconds}s.

code.sub: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {to}. It expires in 10 minutes.
code.didntGetEmail: Didn't get it? Check spam, or <resend>resend code</resend>
code.errExpired: This code has expired. Send a new one.
code.errTooMany: Too many wrong codes. Send a new one.
code.errWrong: That code isn't right. {left, plural, one {# try} other {# tries}} left.
code.errResendSoon: Wait {seconds}s before asking for a new code.

newpass.title: Choose a new password
newpass.sub: For {email}. You'll be logged in right after, and logged out on other devices.
newpass.label: New password
newpass.errRules: Your password needs all 4 items below.
newpass.errReused: Use a password you haven't used before.
newpass.errExpired: Your reset code has expired. Go back and ask for a new one.

phonename.title: Almost done
phonename.sub: This number is new to VirtualBiz. What should shops call you?
phonename.name: Full name
phonename.errEmail: Check this email, or leave it empty.
phonename.errEmailTaken: This email already has an account. Log in with email to add your phone.
phonename.errExpired: Your phone check has expired. Go back and send a new code.
